title: 第1748章 斩奎瓦第1747章 死亡之球
content_zh:
第1748章斩奎瓦
“光靠这道邪术，你还奈何不了我！”
在那死亡之球隆隆镇下间，肖恩抬头冷笑，也不与其废话。
而后林凡双手陡然结印，体内星辰之力在此时毫无保留的爆发开来，印法变幻，只见得在肖恩头顶，有着一片巨大的星空浮现。
“吼！”
而在星空浮现时，只见得小伦也不怠慢，双目微闭，有着神秘光影出现在了身躯表面，神秘光影足踏星辰，散发着惊人的玄气波动。
然后众人便是有些震惊的见到，在那星空之中，一头和小伦血脉相连，神态相似的巨兽，高傲盘踞。
一种无法形容的威压之感，荡漾在了这天地之间。
犹如真正的神兽降世！
“好厉害的神诀，竟然能够具备出一丝真正神兽的血脉！”
在那虚空中，那石总指挥也是两眼一亮，然后饶有兴致的望着盘踞虚空的神秘巨兽。
他倒是很想看看，这三个突然出现在战场，境界低得不像话的家伙，这一番的融合技能，究竟能不能抗衡这魔族的第五统领。
或许，他依然是认为肖恩三个用秘法遮掩了自身的境界，但年龄却骗不了人，再加上是从低端战场上来的，充其量也不会超出大藏境三重。
不管是不是因为玉龙战车的加持，但整辆战车真正能够发挥出实力的，便是肖恩三个，这是不争的事实。
但那种种手段，即便是拥有大藏境七重实力的他，都已经开始感到望尘莫及。
那般强悍无匹的波动，顿时让得下方的人魔双方强者面色剧变。
这一招，他们可绝对接不下来！
他们没想到这叫小魔头的，竟然还藏着这般手段，难怪敢上到中端战场，挑战这魔族的第五统领。
“无以伦比！”
天空之上，肖恩冷喝。

“吼！”
星空之中，巨兽仰天长啸，旋即踏破星空，化为—道天火缭绕，脑悬烈日的巨大的光虹，贯穿了天空。
然后携带着滔天声势，转之间，便是与那冲击而来的死亡之球，重重相撞。
砰！砰！砰！
震耳欲聋的玄气爆炸，连绵不断的在那天空之上响彻而起。
“吼！”
巨兽咆哮着，一道道神秘纹路在它身上浮现而出，而后在其头顶，形成了一片焚天火海。
“呜呜！”
那死亡之球也是转动起来，无穷魔影源源不绝的涌出，犹如一片九幽地狱在天地显化，任何攻势，都是无法将其突破。
“哼，我这死亡之球能够吸收攻击，凭你也想突破？痴人说梦！”
奎瓦统领冷笑道。
“是吗？”
肖恩眼中寒芒一闪，拳印再变，一声低喝，自其心中响起：“爆！”
轰！
就在心中喝声刚刚落下，那巨兽脑后烈日，便是爆发出了刺眼的光芒，
content_en:
Chapter 1748 Killing Kuiwa
"You can't do anything to me just with this evil magic!"
As the ball of death rumbled down, Sean raised his head and sneered, not talking nonsense.
Then Lin Fan suddenly formed seals with his hands, and the power of the stars in his body exploded unreservedly at this time. The seals changed, and a huge starry sky appeared above Sean's head.
"Roar!"
When the starry sky emerged, Xiao Lun was seen to be no slouch. His eyes were slightly closed, and a mysterious light and shadow appeared on the surface of his body. The mysterious light and shadow stepped on the stars, exuding astonishing fluctuations of profound energy.
Then everyone was a little shocked to see, in the starry sky, a giant beast that was connected by blood to Xiao Lun and had a similar look, standing proudly.
An indescribable feeling of pressure rippled between the heaven and the earth.
It's like a real mythical beast coming to the world!
"What a powerful divine art, it can actually produce a trace of the blood of a real divine beast!"
In the void, Commander Shi's eyes lit up, and then he looked at the mysterious beast entrenched in the void with great interest.
He really wanted to see if the fusion skills of these three guys who suddenly appeared on the battlefield and were of ridiculously low level could compete with the fifth leader of the demon clan.
Perhaps, he still thinks that Sean and the others have used secret techniques to hide their own realms, but age cannot deceive others. In addition, they come from low-end battlefields, and at best they will not exceed the third level of the Great Tibet Realm.
Regardless of whether it is because of the blessing of the Jade Dragon Chariot, it is the three Seans who can really display the strength of the entire chariot. This is an indisputable fact.
But those kinds of methods have begun to feel beyond his reach even if he has the seventh level of strength in the Great Tibetan Realm.
Such powerful fluctuations immediately caused the expressions of the powerful men and demons below to change drastically.
They will definitely not be able to take this move!
They didn't expect this little devil to have such tricks. No wonder he dared to go to the middle battlefield and challenge the fifth leader of the devil clan.
"Unmatched!"
Above the sky, Sean shouted coldly.
"Roar!"
In the starry sky, the giant beast looked up to the sky and roared, and immediately stepped through the starry sky, turning into a huge light rainbow with sky fire lingering and the scorching sun hanging above its head, penetrating the sky.
Then, carrying a huge momentum, in a blink of an eye, it collided heavily with the attacking ball of death.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Deafening profound energy explosions resounded continuously in the sky.
"Roar!"
The giant beast roared, mysterious lines appeared on its body, and then a sky-burning sea of fire formed above its head.
"Woo!"
The ball of death also started to rotate, and endless demonic shadows poured out in an endless stream, like a nine-nether hell manifesting in the heaven and earth. No offensive attack could break through it.
"Hmph, my ball of death can absorb attacks, but you also want to break through? You're talking nonsense!"
Commander Kueva sneered.
"Really?"
A cold light flashed in Sean's eyes, his fist seal changed again, and a low cry sounded in his heart: "Explode!"
Boom!
Just as the shouts in his heart fell, the scorching sun behind the giant beast's head burst out with dazzling light.
